newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: MSAS to build Eindhoven distribution site.
newsitem.headline: MSAS to build Eindhoven distribution site.

text.p: UK-based global freight forwarder MSAS Cargo International said it is to build a new distribution facility near Eindhoven, Netherlands.

Work on the new 20,000 square-metre warehousing and distribution facility will probably begin in September, said Mischa de Boer, trade director of MSAS in the Netherlands. It will be finished by spring 1998.
Already, he said, it is likely the facility will be extended by 10,000 square-metres in the next one to two years, because of strong demand.
MSAS has a 20,000 square-metre site near Antwerp which is mainly for hi-tech manufacturers. -Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017
